title: Forced to Evacuate Amid Spain Wildfires, Residents Wonder if Their Homes Still Stand
summary_full: In central Spain, thousands of people sleep in shelters or in their cars, some of them evacuated multiple times ahead of the advancing flames, awaiting word on what they left behind.
